dialogues.speaker: Scratched-Out Treasure Hoarder Notes
dialogues.text: "What in the world is the solution to this puzzle...?"

dialogues.speaker: Scratched-Out Treasure Hoarder Notes
dialogues.text: "It's not like I have Boss to help either... she sent me to investigate this on my own. But it's going to take me forever!"

dialogues.speaker: Scratched-Out Treasure Hoarder Notes
dialogues.text: "I'm to the point where I'm trying to crack this puzzle in my dreams, or maybe nightmares is more accurate... I saw an old man squatting beside me with a wide grin, urging me to hurry up and solve the puzzle."

dialogues.speaker: Scratched-Out Treasure Hoarder Notes
dialogues.text: "Hmm, no... was it an old man or a young girl? ...Ugh, I can't remember."

dialogues.speaker: Scratched-Out Treasure Hoarder Notes
dialogues.text: "Anyway, I'll stick it out a few more days. If I still can't figure it out after that, I'll just have to get Boss to send someone else..."
